llm_response.reason: The site mimics a designer brand (Pinko) with heavy emphasis on sales and discounts, uses an off-brand domain, provides no business address, phone number, or professional contact information, and only offers a generic contact form. There is no verification it is an authorized reseller. These are common traits in fake online stores designed to defraud customers by selling counterfeit or nonexistent goods, and the generic, untraceable business setup further confirms the scam risk.
